mapper.insert: insert into product_type (parent_id, name, description, type_code, sort, status, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{typeCode}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update product_type set is_del = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select id, parent_id, name, description, type_code, sort, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from product_type where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
select id, parent_id, name, description, type_code, sort, status, is_del, create_time, update_time from product_type where type_code = #{typeCode} and is_del = 0
mapper.update: update product_type set parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, type_code = #{typeCode}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from product_type where parent_id = #{parentId} and is_del = 0
